nodes.title: Fraction Parts
nodes.objective: Identify a fraction as equal parts of a whole.
nodes.concept: A fraction names part of a whole.
nodes.explanation: The numerator tells how many equal parts we have. The denominator tells how many equal parts make the whole.

visual.text: Imagine a whole divided into equal parts.

nodes.title: Equivalent Fractions
nodes.objective: Recognize two fractions that represent the same quantity.
nodes.concept: Equivalent fractions name the same amount.
nodes.explanation: For example, 1/2 and 2/4 represent the same part of a whole.

visual.text: Split each half into two equal parts to see 2/4.

nodes.title: Adding Fractions
nodes.objective: Add fractions with the same denominator.
nodes.concept: Keep the denominator and add the numerators.

visual.text: Combine equal fifths into a larger collection of fifths.

questions.prompt: What does the denominator tell us?
options: How many equal parts make the whole
